integrity: The two-tract formulas are derived algebraically from the standard index definitions. A separate exact-rational verifier enumerates every raw configuration through the first boundary, independently canonicalizes tract/group symmetries, reconstructs the closed formulas, certifies the unique first strict reversal, and checks the all-N continuation family.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to exactly two nonempty tracts, exactly two groups with equal citywide totals, and the classical aspatial dissimilarity and isolation indices. The cutoff is an integer-census boundary and does not address sampling uncertainty or spatially weighted segregation measures.
title: Dissimilarity and isolation first strictly reverse with eight members per group
